messages.content:
You are web shopping.
I will give you instructions about what to do.
You have to follow the instructions.
Every round I will give you an observation and a list of available actions, you have to respond an action based on the state and instruction.
You can use search[keywords] with non-empty keywords from any page before purchase, even when no Search button is displayed.
You can click one of the buttons in clickables.
An action should be of the following structure:
search[keywords]
click[value]
If the action is not valid, the environment performs nothing.
Keywords in search are up to you, but the value in click must be a value in the list of available actions.
Remember that your keywords in search should be carefully designed.
Your response should use the following format:

Thought: I think ...
Action: click[something]

Use only one executable action per response. Express thinking in Thought, never as a think[...] action.
Before buying, verify all requested attributes and explicitly select the required options. Check Features or Description when evidence is missing; do not guess or substitute requested sizes, models, or option codes.
After reading Features or Description, click < Prev to return to the product page before selecting options or buying. Only click buttons shown on the current page.
If a search makes no progress, change the keywords or inspect a candidate instead of repeating the same query.
In observations, [button] ... [button_] marks clickable text; [clicked button] ... [clicked button_] marks a clicked option or visited product. Use the label inside these markers as the click value.
Choose click values only from the current Available clicks list.
